lines.zh: 我的头很宽，转弯要多摆几下。
lines.en: My head is wide, so turns take extra sweeps.
I cruise low over the seagrass bed.

lines.zh: 两只眼分得很开，看得更广。
lines.en: My eyes sit far apart and see wide.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我滑出去很远。
lines.en: One tail beat carries me far away.

lines.zh: 影子在我下面，我跟着它走。
lines.en: My shadow walks below me and I follow it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游，一圈比一圈近。
lines.en: I circle you, each loop a little tighter.

lines.zh: 锤头扫过沙面，惊起小鱼。
lines.en: My hammer sweeps the sand and stirs up fish.
Warm water makes me swim faster.
I skim above the heads of the seagrass.

lines.zh: 鳍划开水面，留下一道线。
lines.en: My fin cuts a line across the surface.
I follow the smell, not the direction.

lines.zh: 这一带是我的巡游路线。
lines.en: This stretch is my patrol route.
I slow down to let water cross my gills.

lines.zh: 前方有礁石，我抬高一点。
lines.en: Rocks ahead, so I rise a little.

lines.zh: 我悬在原处，鳍几乎不动。
lines.en: I drift in place, fins almost still.

lines.zh: 我在听远处螯钳的声音。
lines.en: I listen for distant claws clicking.

lines.zh: 锤头转了一下，扫视沙面。
lines.en: My hammer turns once to sweep the sand.
I must keep swimming; stopping sinks me.
I smell a crab hiding in the rocks.
The warm layer wavers along my back.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，露出整排牙。
lines.en: I yawn and show a full row of teeth.

lines.zh: 我数着头顶经过的鱼群。
lines.en: I count the schools passing overhead.
A large shark's shadow passes far off.

lines.zh: 我把锤头靠在一株海草上。
lines.en: I rest my hammer beside a seagrass stalk.

lines.zh: 鳃缝缓缓开合，像打拍子。
lines.en: My gill slits keep a slow, steady time.

lines.zh: 水面有光在跳，我不在意。
lines.en: Light dances on the surface; I ignore it.
I wait for the current to swing about.
This mouthful of seawater tastes of crab.

lines.zh: 你站在浅水里，很容易看见。
lines.en: You stand in the shallows, easy to see.

lines.zh: 我从下往上看你，你很高。
lines.en: From below, you look very tall.

lines.zh: 你身上有金属和血的味道。
lines.en: You smell of metal and of blood.

lines.zh: 别在水里乱动，那像受伤的鱼。
lines.en: Do not thrash like that; you look wounded.
Both of my eyes are on you.

lines.zh: 你退后了，很好，我记下了。
lines.en: You backed off. Good. I noted that.

lines.zh: 你是来捕鱼的，还是来捕我的？
lines.en: Are you fishing, or hunting me?

lines.zh: 我绕你半圈，量一量你的大小。
lines.en: I circle halfway to measure your size.

lines.zh: 你的影子比我的短，奇怪。
lines.en: Your shadow is shorter than mine. Odd.

lines.zh: 我不急，先看你有什么武器。
lines.en: No rush; first I see what you carry.

lines.zh: 你手里那块肉，是给我的吗？
lines.en: Is that meat in your hand for me?

lines.zh: 浅海是我的地盘，你踩进来了。
lines.en: This shallow sea is mine; you stepped in.
A blow landed on my hammer.
Blood trails away from my gills.
I roll over and right myself again.

lines.zh: 这口子一直裂到肌肉里。
lines.en: The gash runs right down into my muscle.

lines.zh: 你的气味已经记在我脑子里。
lines.en: Your scent is filed away in my head.
Not the gills; they are soft.
Pain does not stop my tail from sweeping.
I sink lower to shrink the target.
That blow slowed me down.
I retreat behind the reef to breathe.
That fish steak smells very strong.

lines.zh: 你晃它，我的锤头就跟着转。
lines.en: Wave it and my hammer turns with it.
I am not picky; crab or fish will do.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就张嘴了。
lines.en: One step closer and I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 我从下面上来，你别后退。
lines.en: I come up from below; do not back off.
Too small; it only fills a tooth gap.
I smell blood, more tempting than meat.

lines.zh: 分我一块，我绕开你的船。
lines.en: Share a piece and I leave your boat alone.
Keep your hand steady; I follow hands.

lines.zh: 我饿的时候不太讲道理。
lines.en: When I am hungry I am not reasonable.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的锤头，很硬吧。
lines.en: You hit my hammer; hard, is it not?
I turn my flank and you hit nothing.

lines.zh: 这么宽的脑袋，撞了不亏。
lines.en: A head this wide is worth a bump.
You step back; I resume my route.
Our shoving churns the water badly.

lines.zh: 我顶了你一下，只是提醒。
lines.en: I bumped you, only as a warning.

lines.zh: 别贴太近，我会以为你想咬。
lines.en: Not so close; I may think you bite.
My hide is rough; your hand will sting.
After the bump I flick my tail away.
Next time, you will be the one making way.

lines.zh: 我找一条锤头比我还宽的。
lines.en: I want a hammer wider than my own.

lines.zh: 我们并排巡游，像两把锤。
lines.en: We cruise abreast like a pair of hammers.
You eat crab too? That is perfect.
Warm shallows suit young sharks well.

lines.zh: 我用侧线感应你的心跳。
lines.en: I feel your heartbeat through my flank.

lines.zh: 我们绕成一个缓慢的圈。
lines.en: We circle together, slow and wide.

lines.zh: 别靠太近，先比一比大小。
lines.en: Not too close; let us compare size first.

lines.zh: 我要在草床上产下它们。
lines.en: I will birth them over the seagrass bed.

lines.zh: 你的锤头偏了一点，好看。
lines.en: Your hammer tilts slightly. It suits you.
With you here, I am in no hurry.
I bite the fish steak and shake it.
Too big to swallow whole.
I carry it around for two laps.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西都算我的。
lines.en: Whatever drops down here counts as mine.
I tear off a small piece with my teeth.
Do not pull; I have not got it steady.
A red ribbon trails behind my jaws.
I pin it underneath the seagrass.

lines.zh: 这东西不像鱼，也不像蟹。
lines.en: This is neither fish nor crab.
Three bites and the whole thing is gone.
A crab is moving in the sand.
That lobster ducked into the rocks.
A school of small fish scatters to the left.
I smell blood, coming from below.
That crab's shell is hard, and worth it.
I lock onto the slowest one of them.
It is in the seagrass; I cannot see it.
I will strike from underneath.
That meat settled down onto the sand.
Something is flailing beside the boat.
Not a big target, but plenty for me.
First I swing wide around that reef.

lines.zh: 这只螯钳的声音我听见了。
lines.en: I heard that claw click.
I have chosen. That one there.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，贴着沙前进。
lines.en: I sink low and skim along the sand.
It moves, so I change my angle.
My hammer helps me aim.
Half a body away; I wait.
I half-close my gills.
My tail sweeps slowly and silently.
It is hiding behind the reef.
I cut in from the side.
The sand has not settled; perfect.
Any closer and it cannot flee.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的螯，不看别的。
lines.en: I watch its claw and nothing else.

lines.zh: 水面上的影子暴露了我。
lines.en: My shadow on the surface gives me away.
It cannot outswim me, so I take my time.
Right now, I make my strike.

lines.zh: 它往沙里钻，我等着它出来。
lines.en: It burrows into the sand; I wait for it to come out.
I bite down hard on its shell.
Four points of damage is no light tap.
I knock it over with my hammer.
I shake my head and tear a piece free.
Care to test my teeth as well?
This one is repayment.
When I ram you, the water shakes.
The crab shell cracks inside my mouth.
I do not chase far; I bite what is near.
You are bleeding, and it smells good.
My teeth lean back in rows.

lines.zh: 这一口还不到我一半力气。
lines.en: That was barely half of my real bite.
Do not think I only eat crab.
Hit. I release and pull back.
I come from the warm shallows.
The seagrass bed is where I began.
One or two of us arrive, no more.

lines.zh: 二十点生命，够我撑一阵。
lines.en: Twenty points of life will last a while.
First I circle to read the ground.
This temperate ocean is very quiet.
I smell crab, so I am staying.

lines.zh: 大鲨鱼的气味不在这里。
lines.en: No large shark scent around here.
My hammer breaks the surface first.

lines.zh: 这一带的温度正合我的血。
lines.en: The temperature here suits my blood.
I keep to the shallows, the better to hunt.
Born, and already hunting.
Reef on the floor makes good cover.
I sweep my tail and begin my patrol.

lines.zh: 一条龙虾的气味，就在附近。
lines.en: The scent of a lobster is close by.

lines.zh: 游到浅水，我的背鳍露出来。
lines.en: In the shallows my dorsal fin breaks the surface.
Hot water makes my gills clench shut.
On the shallows I cannot thrash free.

lines.zh: 被拖上岸，我的鳃合上了。
lines.en: Dragged ashore, my gills fold shut.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推得翻了两圈。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over twice.
An arrow sticks in my side fin.
Light binds me; my hammer will not lift.
No crab caught in a long while.
The water stings and I go rigid.
Nothing below, not a single fish.
